question: Suraj starts from Point A and travels 8 km to the north. He then takes a right turn and travels 9 km, takes another right turn and travels 10 km, then takes a left turn and travels 5 km. Finally, he takes a left turn and travels 2 km to reach Point B. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction must he travel to return to Point A? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Suraj starts from Point A and travels 8 km to the north. He then takes a right turn and travels 9 km, takes another right turn and travels 10 km, then takes a left turn and travels 5 km. Finally, he takes a left turn and travels 2 km to reach Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c134cd5ca81b3cd487727f56aa995af1777477bad064de5c6c77474bcf9fa7.png] 

Thus, he must travel 14 km towards the west to return to Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
